g.text: Kenji Tanaka, Elena Varga, Amir Hassan, Sophia Liu
We demonstrate non-Abelian braiding of photonic modes in a synthetic frequency dimension realized by a modulated
silicon nitride microring. By mapping N=21 frequency modes to lattice sites with tunable coupling /2 = 180 MHz and
implementing PT-symmetric gain/loss γ = 0. 25, we realize a (2+1)D Chern insulator with C=1. Adiabatic encircling of
exceptional points braids degenerate edge states with fidelity 0. 98 ± 0. 01.
